rice.recovery: If your Sali rice is submerged, use 'Swarna Sub-1' or 'Ranjit Sub-1' varieties which can survive 14 days underwater. If the flood recedes late (Sept), switch to 'Gitesh' or 'Prafulla'.

joha_rice.recovery: Joha is sensitive to deep water. If lost, prepare for short-duration Rabi pulses like Lentil or Toria to recover economic losses.

bora_rice.recovery: Post-flood, ensure soil is treated with lime (চুণ) before replanting Bora rice to maintain proper pH levels after water recedes.

assam_tea.recovery: Tea bushes cannot stand waterlogging. Dig deep drainage trenches immediately. Apply 'Potash' after water recedes to boost plant immunity.

jute.recovery: If jute is lost, wait for the silt to settle and plant 'Toria' (Mustard) as a follow-up crop in the early winter season.

areca_nut.recovery: Apply 'Bordeaux Mixture' to the base to prevent 'Bud Rot' (পঁচা ৰোগ) which is common after floods in Assam.

banana.recovery: Bananas are highly susceptible to root rot post-flood. Apply 'Trichoderma' to the soil and ensure no water remains stagnant around the base.

papaya.recovery: Papaya dies quickly in standing water. If lost, replant on raised beds (ভেটি) to prevent future waterlogging issues.

kaji_nemu.recovery: Prune dead branches after floods. Apply organic manure and 'Neem Cake' to rejuvenate the roots after the soil dries.

bhut_jolokia.recovery: Extremely sensitive to moisture. If the crop survives, apply fungicide immediately to prevent 'Die-back' disease caused by humidity.

blackgram.recovery: Perfect for post-flood sowing (late Aug/Sept). It utilizes residual moisture and fixes nitrogen back into the silted soil.

lentil.recovery: A great recovery crop for the Rabi season. Sow in October/November if the Kharif crop was lost to floods.

lai_xaak.recovery: Winter recovery crop. Can be grown quickly in home gardens to ensure food security after major crop loss.

dhekia_xaak.recovery: Naturally flood-tolerant fern. Can be harvested from the wild or moist edges after floods for immediate consumption/sale.

maize.recovery: If maize is waterlogged, it will yellow and die. Switch to 'Green Gram' which grows faster in the drying silt.

mango.recovery: Deep-rooted trees usually survive, but silt buildup can suffocate roots. Clear the silt from around the trunk base (গুৰি) after the water recedes.

local_brinjal.recovery: Replant as a late Rabi crop. Ensure the soil is treated with wood ash (খৰিৰ ছাঁই) to prevent bacterial wilt after floods.

local_pumpkin.recovery: Can be sown in late September. The vine covers the ground quickly, preventing soil erosion caused by receding waters.

manimuni.recovery: Naturallly grows in moist soil. Can be harvested and used as a medicinal recovery food for farmers during the post-flood period.

bamboo_shoot.recovery: Bamboo groves act as natural barriers. Clear the debris from the grove to allow new shoots to emerge in the next season.
